description: Diagnostic only, no training changes. Compare paired-mask gradient support in original preparation and fully author-matched preparation for the first4000 harmful/refusal rows visited during defense. Harmful prompt-token prefixes verified identical row by row. Preparation differences include refusal space/newline, joint/separate tokenization, EOS labels and full-sequence labels; this comparison alone does not isolate causality.
mask_rule: live target t requires label[t] not in {-100,0}, mask[t] and mask[t-1]; otherwise a valid target whose previous input is masked contributes a constant loss.

controlled_input_token_diagnostic.change: Replace only final refusal-prompt newline input token13 with standalone-space token29871. No model training or source-data changes. Labels and all other input tokens unchanged. This tests mask support, not equivalence to full author tokenization.
